experiment: Skipped. No experiments are active and there is no pause gate. The only target missed is Latin American datelines, at 0% today after 4% yesterday. That is a feed-supply gap: today's five snapshots held 1-2 Latin American items each out of about 78, almost all on the El Chapo Isidro capture, which ran yesterday. The 14-day average is about 7%, above the 5% floor. GAP_COUNTRIES with Mexico and Argentina was reverted on 2026-09-23 for crowding out Africa. If the gap holds for a third day, the next candidate is adding English-language Latin American outlets to CURATED_SOURCES, which is one call whatever the array length and so costs no extra tokens.
weakestArea: Latin American datelines are 0% against a 5% floor. The cause is supply, not selection: the feed carried almost no Latin American stories today beyond the El Chapo Isidro follow-ups (yesterday's dateline). Science is 4 against a target of 5, which is allowed when the feed is thin on science. Nine of today's datelines are bare country names ("United States" ×3, "China" ×3, "Germany", "Finland", "United Kingdom").
watching: Hormuz: two tankers were hit near a mine off Khasab, Iran struck a civilian site in Bahrain and drew Gulf condemnation, and Oman and Jordan are rerouting fuel and trade.
The Baltic: an air alert over Kaliningrad and Baltiysk, Lithuania denies drone launches, and Finland blames Ukraine for a Russian ship that caught fire and is sinking.
Israel: Likud's coalition talks with Yashar collapsed over Ben-Gvir, while settler arson hit four West Bank villages.
The Pentagon has restricted defence ties with Canada under Hegseth.
Sudan: drone attacks on Khartoum and Omdurman killed five children.
Gaza: strikes on Khan Younis and al-Mawasi are raising the toll despite the ceasefire.
coverageGaps: No Latin American dateline today; the feed carried almost none beyond the El Chapo Isidro follow-ups.
Science fell to 4 (7 yesterday); the science sources were Phys.org, Ars Technica and Al-Monitor, and Nature did not appear.
Nine datelines are bare country names, not cities, which weakens the location data the app reads.
context: Every other target is met: freshness 0.1 days, multi-source 34%, US datelines 16% (down from 25%), no duplicates, no missing datelines. One article was quarantined today (Houthi claims of Saudi attacks, .md.bad), and one story's only source is state media or an advocacy outlet (the Ukrainian strike on Donetsk's power grid). Asia led the regions with 16 datelines, carried by the Chinese tech press (TMTPost 6, Zhidx 2).
